what: While passing through a tall section (default 500vh), the stage stays pinned at the screen center, and each time scroll progress crosses a step boundary (default evenly split), the sentence group fades out in .4s and the next sentence fades in over .4s (cubic-bezier(.44,0,.56,1)). If a button is placed with the last sentence, it appears at the end

options.cuts: Step boundary progress values (comma-separated, 0~1) — number of sentences minus 1, default split evenly
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Sentence group to swap (as siblings under the same parent)

note: If a boundary is crossed again while switching, once the current switch ends it switches one more time to the final step.

from.where: index.html [data-slot=approach] — original Sentence 1·2·3 variants from the site builder (variant switch length 0) + wrapper transition opacity .4s cubic-bezier(.44,0,.56,1), section height 500vh · stage sticky 100vh
